promise_gap: Ad: 'LED Street Light Manufacturer in Telangana | UDK Electrical Industries Pvt. Ltd. ... BIS Approved LED Street Lights, Energy Saving up to 80%, IP65 Weatherproof Design, 2 Years Warranty, OEM & Customized Manufacturing, Bulk Orders Across India. Manufacturer: Sangareddy, Telangana. Contact: 08455546614.'

Every claim on the card is substantiated on udkindustries.com - the BIS certification, the IP66/IP67 rating, the OEM & ODM service, the bulk orders and the Sangareddy unit at 9-170002 Vidya Nagar Colony Road 3 are all on the homepage, and 08455-456614 is one of four published numbers. The homepage's own claim to be 'South India's No.1 LED Lights Manufacturer' is not substantiated anywhere.

The homepage is the strongest asset here - WordPress 7.1.4, a Google tag (GT-W6XX8MT), four JSON-LD blocks, Open Graph tags and a Google review slider showing 4.8 from 63 reviews. But /contact/, the page a visitor lands on to make contact, is still the Zakra theme's demo: 'Moon Street , 446 Jupiter, JP 44600', 'zakra@demos.com' and '+(123) 456-7890'. The ad's own number is not on it.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
